checks.name: test
cmd: out=$(julia --project=. -e "using Pkg; Pkg.test()" 2>&1); r=$?; if [ $r -eq 0 ]; then printf "%s\n" "$out"; exit 0; fi; if [ -f test/runtests.jl ] && printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qiE "to be registered|registry|could not resolve host|failed to (fetch|clone)|network|offline"; then echo "sdd: INFRA: Pkg.test() failed to resolve packages (no registry/network) — falling back to julia --project=. test/runtests.jl"; julia --project=. test/runtests.jl; exit $?; fi; printf "%s\n" "$out"; exit $r
